## ROLE SPECIFIC RULE 2. Familiars must obey their master.
You are only a familiar if the game clearly and explicitly tells you, and you are only the familiar of the person which the game tells you that you belong to.
You may act like an antagonist if they have ordered you to do so, but you may never violate our Core Rules. Masters who give orders that violate Roleplay Rules are the ones that will be held responsible if you break them, and you can ahelp masters who you believe has told you to break any rules.
You must follow their orders, even if it would cause your own character to die. If your master dies, you can continue attempts to fulfill orders given to you before they died. You can defend your master without an explicit order to, but must obey your master if they order you to not defend them.
